name: VideoQi
author: Robin He

sections.description:
VideoQi is a video widget for your website, embed it on your website and let it answer questions, engage with your users, and more.

With this plugin, you can embed your VideoQi widget directly into your WordPress site.

External services

This plugin embeds a widget that connects to VideoQi server, it’s needed to provide interactive video functionality.

The plugin sends anonymous viewing data (watch time and video ID) to VideoQi during viewing and when the widget is closed.

This service is provided by “VideoQi”: terms of service, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
How do I install VideoQi widget?

  1. Install this plugin to your WordPress website.
  2. Copy your ID from VideoQi top-right corner of the navigation
  3. Go to the “Settings” menu in the sidebar of your WordPress dashboard and select the “VideoQi Settings” tab.
  4. Paste your ID into the designated field.
  5. Click “Save Changes”.
